description: This file defines API endpoints using FastAPI for managing contracts, including listing contracts, retrieving details and insights, and uploading PDFs for extraction and analysis. It integrates with a database via SQLAlchemy, handles file uploads, and interfaces with external services like OpenAI for text analysis.
